ads.headline: Coffee, garlic, long days — handled.
ads.brief: Lifestyle kitchen-bench scene, warm daylight: espresso cup and a garlic bulb on a slate board, casual and real. The real LACALUT FLORA toothpaste tube (German pack) and real FLORA mouthwash bottle rendered EXACTLY as the attached reference packshots — identical labels, colours and wording, never redrawn — standing together large in the foreground right, labels to camera, crisp. NO laptop, NO screens anywhere in the scene. Small supporting tagline: "Made in Germany for over 100 years."
